title: Ashbury Rewards Dining Allowance Carry-over on Guest Folios and the Member's Self-Service Tool
content:
A member whose tier entitles them to the elite breakfast benefit may carry what remains of a day's dining allowance to one food and beverage line charged at the hotel's outlets on that business date, and applies the carry-over personally. Unused allowance is never paid out and never carried to another business date. This is an Ashbury Rewards benefit on Guest Folios, applied by the member in person.

## Carry-over rule

The part of a day's dining allowance carried to a food and beverage line is fixed only after every breakfast line of that business date carries its elite breakfast credit.

Put the other way: while any breakfast line of that business date stands on the folio without its elite breakfast credit, the carry-over for that date is not yet fixed.

| Element | Rule |
|---|---|
| Who | A member whose Ashbury Rewards tier entitles them to the elite breakfast benefit |
| What | What remains of a day's dining allowance |
| Where it goes | One food and beverage line charged at the hotel's outlets on that business date |
| Who applies it | The member, personally |
| What never happens | Unused allowance is never paid out and never carried to another business date |

## The member's tool: `apply_dining_allowance_ccaea779`

**Capability.** The Ashbury Rewards member applies, in person, the unused part of their daily elite dining allowance to one food and beverage charge on the open folio of their current stay. One call books one elite dining credit line in the member's own name that names the food and beverage charge it offsets, dated to that charge's business day, and lowers the folio balance by the amount applied. The member sees the credit printed under that charge on the bill.

**How it is invoked.** `apply_dining_allowance_ccaea779` belongs to the member, not to the agent: the agent unlocks it with `unlock_user_discoverable_tool` and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it with `call_user_discoverable_tool`, supplying the four parameters below.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `folio_id` | The reference number of the guest folio of the stay, as given by the desk | Id |
| `loyalty_member_id` | The reference number of the member's Ashbury Rewards membership, as given by the desk | Id |
| `related_posting_id` | The reference number of the food and beverage charge line the member applies the allowance to, as given by the desk | Id |
| `carry_amount` | The allowance applied | USD, 2 decimal places, always positive; rounded half up to the cent before booking |

**Return.** A receipt with `posting_id` (reference number of the new credit line), `folio_id`, `related_posting_id` (the charge offset), `amount` (USD to 2 decimal places, the allowance applied), `business_date` (YYYY-MM-DD, the charge's business day), `balance_due` (USD to 2 decimal places, the folio balance afterwards) and `status`, which reads "applied" when the credit stands.
